title: RespawnAnchorHUD
description: Look at a respawn anchor to see its charge count (0-4) and whether it works as a spawn point. No popups.
body:
**RespawnAnchorHUD** is a clean look-at info layer for your nether base. Point your crosshair at any **respawn anchor** and a small readout appears in the **top-left** of your screen:

- **Charges: 0-4 / 4** - the anchor's exact charge level
- **Usable spawn point** - when it has at least one charge
- **Uncharged (charge with glowstone)** - when it's empty and won't set your spawn

### Why

Vanilla only hints at a respawn anchor's charge through faint glowing layers on the block - hard to count at a glance, especially in dim nether lighting. RespawnAnchorHUD puts the precise charge count on screen so you instantly know whether your anchor is ready to set spawn, or how much glowstone it still needs, without right-clicking and risking an accidental respawn-point change.

### Details

- Pure client-side info HUD - reads the anchor's vanilla block state only. No mixins, no block entities, no gameplay changes.
- Toggle the HUD on/off with **R**.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21.8 - 1.21.11 (Fabric).
